title: I Can
original_lyrics:
[verse]
I can lose myself in the beauty of song
I can climb to the top of cloud in the sky
I can soar through the heavens like graceful eagle
I can swing from the wings of butter-fly
I can chase the wind down the canyons of my mind
I can catch it in the corner of my memory
I can make it breathe breath of life into an old love that has died
And I can stand and reminisce while

[intro]
Except make my mind forget you
I can take journey to the end of the rainbow
I can go there and back and never leave my room
I can change heartache into tiny snowflake
And I can take December and turn it into June

[intro]
Except make my mind forget you
